includes_schedules: Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses - General Fund

notes: Cash basis (modified cash). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6), which already eliminates 225,000 of internal transfers (General to Depreciation 200,000 and General to Activity 25,000); the 'Transfers from other funds' line is '-' in the total column so not recorded. The printed 'Transfer to Nutrition Fund' 200,000 line sits inside printed total disbursements 22,089,475, so it is recorded as transfers_out and excluded from the disbursement items (includes transfers_out). Roll-forward: 7,028,581 + 22,269,259 - 21,889,475 - 200,000 = 7,208,365. Business-type = Nutrition Fund (p8): 63,551 + 563,286 - 761,492 + 200,000 transfer = 65,345; business-type receipts total is operating receipts only (printed 563,286), transfer in business_type.transfers_net. General Fund Other 13,818 split into rent 1,250 and other local 12,568 using the p9 budget schedule. State categorical and Federal programs are counted under instruction (review). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p9) used for General Fund; its Building and grounds 1,958,583 includes a 200,000 transfer to Depreciation (eliminated on p6), shown as a contra line plus an other financing line; General Fund 'Transfers' 225,000 is the Nutrition 200,000 plus Activity 25,000; detail_totals for General Fund expenditure 19,880,819 = items 19,455,819 + other financing 425,000. Bond fund Debt service actual is '-' (0). Depreciation fund budget total expenditure not printed (single line). Other governmental funds have no budget columns. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (Total column, p1), no liabilities; scope government-wide since it includes capital assets. Component unit (Foundation) excluded. The v8 re-trim added report pp50-53 (trimmed pp14-17), the object-level 'Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses - General Fund' schedule; its object lines replace the 12 function-only General Fund program lines of the p9 budget schedule (no double counting; each program subtotal equals the p9 line, General administration 516,121 = Board 27,480 + Executive 488,641). The budget schedule keeps the Building and grounds contra line and the transfer lines (p17 prints the same Transfers 225,000 breakdown); its expenditure total 19,880,819 (p9, also p17) counts the new schedule via includes_schedules. Software and periodicals counted as supplies; mileage to parents as travel. Read pages 1-17 of 17.
